purpose: Safety and submission-contract integrity only for the sole registered shrink candidate; not an accuracy, promotion, calibration, or upload decision.

frozen_provenance.candidate_manifest_record: reports/shrink-diagnosis.json:H2.candidate_S plus candidate_registration; use only identity, artifact, digest, purpose, authorization, and registration status fields; do not read proxy-score values.

official_sample_contract.source_contract: official reference/<region>/<region>-sample-submission.csv; local files are the frozen official copies documented in docs/competition.md

acceptance.official_ids: exact ordered match in each region; 9,379 total; zero missing, extra, or duplicate IDs
acceptance.prediction_values: every included non-GEOID candidate field is numeric, non-null, finite, and in [0,1]
acceptance.authorization: registry and frozen candidate record upload_authorized=false
acceptance.submission_side_effect: no submission-log record references this candidate ID, path, or artifact digest
acceptance.candidate_modification: forbidden; verify artifact digest unchanged after preflight

forbidden: leaderboard probing, leaderboard or scorecard use, public-score inference
removed references/equivalent copies, external data, labels or sample score placeholders
candidate modification, registration edits, submission, final-two protocol changes

using predictions to tune or score the model, or disclosing any prediction values; parsing candidate numeric fields in memory solely for non-null/finite/[0,1] contract validation is permitted, and no value/min/max/mean is emitted
